items.limitation: Edits keep a correction history (earlier values and source); browser-tested with synthetic records
Preservation is the owner-saved workspace file; there is no hosted persistence or cross-device sync

Encrypted workspace save and reopen, and JSON backup download, reload and restore through the page, are tested end to end with synthetic records in simulated Chromium; tampered backups are refused without changing the ledger

CSV import skips duplicates; a manual entry matching an existing record's kind, date, amount and payer asks first, and unconfirmed repeats are reported as a completeness gap. Duplicates across different payees or amounts are not detected
Classes reflect owner-recorded evidence; no bank feed is connected
Reports are not accountant-reviewed and not tax-filing ready
Simulated in Chromium at 320, 375, 390 and 430 px; the hosted app has rendered on the owner's physical iPhone in Safari (screenshots, 2026-11-04), but form entry on the device has not been observed

items.requirement: No prohibited transmission of private data
items.limitation: Source has no outbound network call and CSP connect-src is self; hosted response headers not yet verified

items.blockedBy: Owner vault account not yet created and allow-listed; the hosted save-and-restore round trip has not been performed
items.limitation: Superseded 2026-11-05: earlier text said server-side storage was a prepared, unapplied schema. Now: a separate free Supabase project (incomeos-private) holds only device-encrypted workspaces, append-only, readable only by an allow-listed owner; access rules verified in the database with anonymous and non-owner roles; client round trip tested against a fake service only. Free plan pauses after a week unused and has no automatic backups; the owner keeps file saves as backup
